decisions.reason: Despite limited website presence, the firm's sunk investment in the black-finish line and its fit with core drainage keep escalation strong, though the chance of withdrawal rises slightly after two years of weak results.
The dedicated website page signals public commitment and the product is close to the established offer, so management continues to justify the launch and keeps the drop probability very low.

Substantial development costs for the pump-assisted line and its building on existing technology create strong sunk-cost and commitment pressures, so even with only moderate visibility we keep it, with only a modest chance of dropping.
Because the tileable floor drain has its own page and lies at the core of the firm's established drainage products, high public commitment makes withdrawal very unlikely.
As a central design-led drain grate with its own page, it embodies the announced aesthetic direction, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it with minimal drop risk.
